issues.issue: Whether the claimant is homosexual, so as to be a member of a particular social group (sexual orientation) under s.96
issues.applicant_position: Claims he is homosexual and fears persecution in Turkey after his father beat him and threatened him with a gun.
issues.result_quote: the panel is not persuaded, on a balance of probabilities, that the claimant is homosexual

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces a danger of torture in Turkey (s.97(1)(a))
issues.applicant_position: Did not allege a danger of torture in Turkey.
issues.result_quote: The panel determines that the claimant does not face a danger of torture in Turkey.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces a personalized risk to life or cruel treatment in Turkey (s.97(1)(b))
issues.applicant_position: Risk to life and cruel treatment flows from his alleged sexual orientation.
issues.result_quote: the panel is not persuaded that the claimant faces a personalized risk upon return to Turkey
